summary: A mixed day balancing retail cost pressures and regulatory developments. Retail inflation forecast to spike to 5.47% in September amid food price increases, while SEBI derivatives guidelines and Nat Habit's Rs 142 crore funding round signal market activity.

bullets.text: SEBI to issue derivatives settlement-price mechanism (CAS) guidelines within one week, says chairman Tuhin Kanta Pandey.
India's retail inflation forecast to rise to 5.47% in September from 4.82% in August, driven by sharp food price increases: UBI report.
Diet Coke price raised to Rs 70 per can in Delhi-NCR, Mumbai, Bengaluru, and Goa amid aluminium cost squeeze.
Nat Habit raises Rs 142 crore Series C funding to achieve 5x manufacturing capacity expansion and 2 lakh store network.
Delhi court rules asking questions to minister is not defamation; dismisses Parvesh Verma plea as approached with unclean hands.
